title: Running a studio on 6 to 16 hours a week.
description: How ideaSquared works on 6 to 16 hours a week: one focus at a time, a spend cap, reused tooling, and an honest account of what that means for money and pace.
lede: ideaSquared is one person, part-time, alongside a full-time job. Here is how that shapes the rules we keep, and where it costs us.
summary: What running a one-person studio on 6 to 16 hours a week looks like: the rules, the spend cap, the reused tools, and a venture that is waiting its turn.
